title: Primary Data Analysis for ONT Fungal Barcodes
author: Stephen D Douglas Russell

steps.title: Prepare Working Environment
steps.instruction: Set up the directory structure and download necessary software tools.

substeps.instruction: Open a terminal (command line window).
Create a new folder on the desktop for the experiment (the 'working directory') and change directories into it: `mkdir ~/Desktop/ONT` then `cd ~/Desktop/ONT`.
Create a folder named 'pod5' within the working directory: `mkdir ./pod5`.
Download and unzip the 'Programs.zip' folder to the Desktop.
Download the latest `specimux.py` script from the GitHub repository and save it into the unzipped Programs folder on the Desktop.

steps.title: Import Raw Sequencing Data
steps.instruction: Move the raw sequencing files into the working directory's pod5 folder.

substeps.instruction: If using POD5 format (preferred): Copy all pod5 files from the MinKNOW data folder (`/var/lib/minknow/data/*run-name*/*cell-name*/*long_UID*/pod5/`) to the `./pod5` folder via drag-and-drop or command line: `cp -r /var/lib/minknow/data/*run-name*/*cell-name*/*long_UID*/pod5/ ./pod5`.

If using legacy FAST5 format: Move FAST5 files into a folder named 'fast5' in the working directory, then convert to POD5 using: `pod5 convert fast5 ./fast5/*.fast5 --output ./pod5/ --one-to-one ./fast5`.

steps.title: Create Sample Index File
steps.instruction: Generate a tab-delimited index file to link reads with specimens.

substeps.instruction: Use the extraction template (e.g., NANOPORE TEMPLATE SEVENTH RUN.xlsx) for 10 plates (960 specimens) with ITS1F and ITS4 primers.
Input Lab Code and iNaturalist # (or Mushroom Observer -MO or MyCoPortal -MP numbers).
Remove most final columns from the template so the output is a tab-delimited text file.
Save the final file as `Index.txt` in the Programs folder.

steps.title: Basecall Raw Data
steps.instruction: Run Dorado basecalling in simplex mode using the super-accuracy model.

substeps.instruction: Execute the command: `dorado basecaller sup --no-trim ./pod5/ > ONT.raw.bam`.
Note: For a Flongle cell (1.15Gb bases, 300-1.5M reads), this may take 2 hours or more.

steps.title: Filter Reads by Length
steps.instruction: Perform initial length filtering to remove extra long and short reads.

substeps.instruction: Activate the environment: `conda activate NGSpeciesID`.
Filter for Full ITS (typically maintaining Chanterelles) using: `samtools view -e 'length(seq)>400 && length(seq) 100 && length(seq)<700' -O BAM -o ONT.filtered.bam ONT.raw.bam`.

steps.title: Convert BAM to FASTQ
steps.instruction: Convert the filtered BAM files to FASTQ format for downstream compatibility.

substeps.instruction: Run: `samtools fastq ONT.filtered.bam > ONT.filtered.fastq`.
Deactivate the environment: `conda deactivate`.

steps.title: Organize Analysis Directory
steps.instruction: Set up the NGSpeciesID folder and copy necessary files.

substeps.instruction: Create the directory: `mkdir NGSpeciesID`.
Copy programs and data: `cp ~/Desktop/Programs/* ./NGSpeciesID/`, `cp ONT.filtered.fastq ./NGSpeciesID/`, and `cp ./Index.txt ./NGSpeciesID/`.
Change directory: `cd ./NGSpeciesID`.

steps.title: Demultiplex Samples
steps.instruction: Use Specimux to assign reads to samples based on the index file.

substeps.instruction: Run the script: `python specimux.py Index.txt ONT.filtered.fastq -F -e 3 -E 9 -d`.
Verify that 20% - 40% of reads are properly demultiplexed; if not, check primer and index combinations in `Index.txt`.

steps.title: Clean Up Large Files
steps.instruction: Remove unnecessary large files to optimize final analysis speed.

substeps.instruction: Run: `rm sample_ambiguous.fastq`, `rm sample_unknown.fastq`, and `rm ONT.filtered.fastq`.

steps.title: Generate Consensus Sequences
steps.instruction: Use NGSpeciesID to generate final consensus sequences from demultiplexed samples.

substeps.instruction: Activate the environment: `conda activate NGSpeciesID`.

Run the processing pipeline: `ls *.fastq | parallel NGSpeciesID --ont --consensus --t 1 --abundance_ratio 0.2 --top_reads --sample_size 500 --symmetric_map_align_thresholds --aligned_threshold 0.75 --mapped_threshold 1.0 --medaka --fastq {} --outfolder {.}`.
